We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (three outcomes). Need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We applied 1914389 to one of the outcomes (the one with silyl protecting group). It gave two possible outcomes: first product (C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C) and second product (CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC). The first is likely the correct branch (the silyl protected). Then we applied 1914390 to that first product and got no result. We applied 1914390 to the second product and got none. Then we applied 1914390 to a deprotected version (without Si) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO and got a product: 'CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1'. So that seems a plausible step: 1914390 transforms the allylic alcohol with carbonyl to some ester? Not sure.

Now we need to apply template 149040 to that product. We attempted and got no result. Maybe we need to apply 149040 to a different intermediate earlier. Or maybe we need to choose a different branch from 29646.

Let's examine the three outcomes from 29646:

Result string: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

Three possibilities: (1) silyl on side chain O (maybe protecting the carboxylate?), (2) silyl on the acid group? (3) silyl on the internal OH.

We used the first one (silyl on side chain O). That gave no result for 1914390. The second maybe works.

Let's try applying 1914389 to the second outcome: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO".
